q: How many customers are there?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

q: How many orders have status delivered?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'

q: List the distinct countries of customers
gt: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers

q: How many products cost more than 50000 cents?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price_cents > 50000

q: What is the highest product price in cents?
gt: SELECT MAX(price_cents) FROM products

q: How many orders were placed in 2025?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE placed_at < '2026-01-01'

q: How many payments were paid with paypal?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE method = 'paypal'

q: How many events are of type checkout?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE type = 'checkout'

q: What is the average product price in cents?
gt: SELECT AVG(price_cents) FROM products

q: Names of the first 5 customers by id
gt: SELECT name FROM customers ORDER BY id LIMIT 5

q: How many returns were for damaged items?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns WHERE reason = 'damaged'

q: How many categories have a parent category?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM categories WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL

q: How many addresses are marked as default?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM addresses WHERE is_default = 1

q: What is the minimum unit price in cents among order items?
gt: SELECT MIN(unit_price_cents) FROM order_items

q: Count of orders per status
gt: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

q: Total payment revenue in cents from delivered orders
gt: SELECT SUM(p.amount_cents) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

q: Total payment revenue in cents per customer country
gt: SELECT c.country, SUM(p.amount_cents) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.country

q: How many order items were returned?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON r.order_item_id = i.id

q: Product names that have been returned at least once
gt: SELECT DISTINCT pr.name FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON r.order_item_id = i.id JOIN products pr ON i.product_id = pr.id

q: Average payment amount in cents per payment method
gt: SELECT method, AVG(amount_cents) FROM payments GROUP BY method

q: Number of products per category name
gt: SELECT cat.name, COUNT(*) FROM categories cat JOIN products pr ON pr.category_id = cat.id GROUP BY cat.id

q: Event count per event type for customers from the US
gt: SELECT e.type, COUNT(*) FROM events e JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.country = 'US' GROUP BY e.type

q: Which orders contain more than 3 items?
gt: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

q: Customers who have an address in City1
gt: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN addresses a ON a.customer_id = c.id WHERE a.city = 'City1'

q: Products with total sold quantity of at least 50, with the quantity
gt: SELECT pr.name, SUM(i.qty) FROM order_items i JOIN products pr ON i.product_id = pr.id GROUP BY pr.id HAVING SUM(i.qty) >= 50

q: Total payment amount in cents per month of 2026
gt: SELECT substr(paid_at, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(amount_cents) FROM payments WHERE paid_at >= '2026-01-01' GROUP BY month

q: How many customers never placed an order?
gt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)

q: Return count by reason
gt: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) FROM returns GROUP BY reason

q: Order count per status for customer 1
gt: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = 1 GROUP BY o.status

q: Total quantity sold per product category
gt: SELECT cat.name, SUM(i.qty) FROM order_items i JOIN products pr ON i.product_id = pr.id JOIN categories cat ON pr.category_id = cat.id GROUP BY cat.id

q: Name of the customer who made the single largest payment
gt: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id ORDER BY p.amount_cents DESC LIMIT 1

q: Revenue in cents per product category from orders that were not cancelled
gt: SELECT cat.name, SUM(i.qty * i.unit_price_cents) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN products pr ON i.product_id = pr.id JOIN categories cat ON pr.category_id = cat.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY cat.id

q: What fraction of order items were returned?
gt: SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items)

q: Which product category generated the most revenue in cents, and how much?
gt: SELECT cat.name, SUM(i.qty * i.unit_price_cents) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products pr ON i.product_id = pr.id JOIN categories cat ON pr.category_id = cat.id GROUP BY cat.id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

q: Customers whose average payment exceeds 50000 cents, with the average
gt: SELECT c.id, AVG(p.amount_cents) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id HAVING AVG(p.amount_cents) > 50000

q: Order count per customer country and per status
gt: SELECT c.country, o.status, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.country, o.status

q: The most frequently returned product name and its return count
gt: SELECT pr.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON r.order_item_id = i.id JOIN products pr ON i.product_id = pr.id GROUP BY pr.id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

q: For each parent category, how many products belong to its subcategories?
gt: SELECT p.name, COUNT(*) FROM categories p JOIN categories s ON s.parent_id = p.id JOIN products pr ON pr.category_id = s.id GROUP BY p.id

q: Total payment revenue in cents from German customers for delivered orders
gt: SELECT SUM(p.amount_cents) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.country = 'DE' AND o.status = 'delivered'

q: Average revenue in cents per order, counting each order once
gt: SELECT CAST(SUM(p.amount_cents) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id
